evidence.name: SessionStateTransition

function_ir.summary: Updates the session state pointer at this+0x32BC with the incoming state a2, then runs session-type-gated side effects. When a3 is set, the old state is non-NULL and the new state is NULL (exit transition), it records the vehicle position and race elapsed time via transform helpers and sub_447780. When the old state is not 1 and the new state is 1 (entry to state 1), it queries PositionChangeMonitor, clears session cleanup flags, adjusts the AI speed delta, and zeroes two fields at +17236/+17240 of the session object. A dword_7C569C value of 5 skips the position-recording path.

operations.description: Store the incoming state pointer a2 into this+0x32BC (the session state pointer) and remember the prior value v5; result is a2.
When a3 is zero, and also at the bottom of the exit path, return early if dword_7C569C (session type) is not 5.
Exit-transition guard: requires a3 set, dword_7C569C == 5, new state a2 NULL and prior state v5 non-NULL to enter the position-recording path.
Call F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication on two stack vectors v10/v9 to build the position transform.
Call AIVehiclePathPositionTracking on the same vectors v10/v9.
Read the three position components from this+0x34EC, this+0x34F0 and this+0x34F4 into v11.
Call sub_447780 with the address of dbl_7C7428 and the position vector v11; its result becomes the return value.
Entry-to-state-1 guard: proceed only when the prior state v5 is not 1 and the new state at this+0x32BC equals 1.
Call PositionChangeMonitor(this); if it returns non-NULL, read the dword at its +300 offset into v6.
Call SessionCleanupFlagClear with the session object at *this.
Call AISpeedDeltaSetter with the session object at *this and the position-monitor value v6; its result becomes the return value.
Zero the two dwords at +17236 and +17240 of the session object pointed to by *this.
Return the last computed result (the stored state a2, or the value from sub_447780 or AISpeedDeltaSetter).

unresolved: Meaning of state identifiers (NULL exit, 1 entry) and the session state enum is not specified in the packet.
Offsets +17236/+17240 and v7+300 belong to objects not in the packet field table; semantics of those writes unknown.
dword_7C569C == 5 branch semantics (session type value) not grounded beyond the raw guard.
